reader.requirement: At --std 85 a START statement (a level-2 Relative I-O element) must name a relative file whose access mode is sequential (explicit or default) or dynamic; a START on a file in random access mode is refused, in every form of the 1985 format (with or without the KEY phrase).

edition-consulted.switches: refuses the 2002 FIRST/LAST forms (COBOL0900) below 2002; it does not touch the access-mode screen
Edition.Year < 2002: the mandatory INVALID KEY of SR3 (another rule) on the same statement

reader.edition-search: The SR1 screen itself is `if (file.AccessMode == FileAccessMode.Random) ctx.Edition.Error(IoStatementOperandRule, ...)` in BindStart, with no edition test (EditionContext.Error is unconditional).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb325-start-random-access covers the KEY-phrase form on a random relative (and indexed) file; the KEY-less form and the legal sequential and dynamic arms at 85 are not exercised there

probes.printed: COBOL0862 START on 'XF': the access mode shall be sequential or dynamic, at line 19 (no KEY phrase) and line 20 (KEY IS NOT LESS THAN) (exit 65); identical at --std 2023
probes.expected: both STARTs on ACCESS RANDOM refused (§1985:VIII.4.7.3 SR1)

probes.printed: S1=NIK 00 / S1 REC=BBBB RK=0002 / S2 REC=CCCC RK=0003 / S3=IK 23 / S4 REC=AAAA FS=00 / S5 FS=47
probes.expected: START on ACCESS SEQUENTIAL (>= 2, KEY omitted = EQUAL, > past the last record raises invalid key) and on ACCESS DYNAMIC with a qualified key compile and position correctly; START on a closed file fails 47 (GR1)

probes.printed: COBOL0900 START FIRST/LAST requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0900 START ... WITH LENGTH requires COBOL-2002 (plus COBOL0862 LENGTH requires indexed)
probes.expected: the 2002 FIRST and WITH LENGTH forms are not in the 1985 format and are refused at 85

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.7.3 SR1  (║4.7.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1

reader.notes: BindStart refuses a random-access file before any other screen, at every edition, through COBOL0862; sequential (including the default) and dynamic access bind and run correctly at 85. The diagnostic cites the 2023 clause number only.

refuter.evidence: glbseq-001 at --std 85: START on a GLOBAL relative file declared `ACCESS RANDOM RELATIVE ZK`, issued from a contained program, refused COBOL0862 'the access mode shall be sequential or dynamic' both with KEY IS EQUAL TO ZK (line 53) and with no KEY phrase (line 56). stless-001: the 2002 reverse operators `KEY IS LESS THAN` and `KEY IS <=` refused COBOL0900 at 85, and START on a sequential-organization file refused COBOL0862. The refusal message cites §2023 SR2 (FIRST/LAST), which misleads the diagnosis at 85, but the program is refused and that case is outside this relative-module rule. cite.py: OK  §1985:VIII.4.7.3 SR1  (║4.7.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1.
